description: This Java class defines a command named ModifyFeatureProperties used to modify properties of a feature in an IoT device management context. It includes serialization/deserialization methods, fields for the feature and thing identifiers, and encapsulates the feature properties to be modified.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureProperties
classes.description: A final class representing a command to modify the properties of a feature within a IoT device, providing serialization, deserialization, and accessor methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance with typed ThingId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a ModifyFeatureProperties command.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this command.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the FeatureProperties to be modified.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the feature to modify.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Provides the JSON representation of the entity following the schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the JSON pointer resource path for the command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command data to a JSON object builder.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization settings; returns false.
